current.text: He has a broken foot and will likely miss the start of the season. Yahoo lists him as questionable (foot).
When healthy, he would have been part of the Atlanta rotation.
He has the only non-guaranteed contract on the Hawks. The roster is two players over the limit, and he is one of the candidates to go.
He could be traded or cut before opening day.
If he plays small forward next to Caleb Wilson, he will likely contest fewer shots at the rim, which would cut his blocks.

durable.text: He is a solid defender, a good rebounder and a good steals generator. His shooting is up and down.
He turned 24.5% of his rim contests into blocks.
He scores very little. His projected points are a weak outlier against the top 250 pool.

note: He should not be drafted in our league. Yahoo ranks him 291 and ESPN 267, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he projects about 4.8 points in roughly 15 minutes a game. He also has a broken foot and a non-guaranteed contract. Early in the season, check whether Atlanta keeps him and when he gets healthy. Only a Jalen Johnson injury, which would expose Atlanta's thin power forward depth, would make him a waiver option.
